card.name: Start of a heading or word after a label
card.fires_on: The first piece of a capitalized word or the start of a split word, right after a heading-like word or phrase. Examples are 'Ac' in acute, 'Information' after 'prescribing', and 'Administration' or 'Maintenance' after a treatment term.

modes.label: Section-title words
modes.description: A capitalized noun that completes a label such as prescribing Information or treatment Course.

modes.label: Split word starts
modes.description: The opening piece of a word that is broken into parts, such as acute, Apache, Muses or permanently.
